infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Plant Disease Detector to access your camera to photograph leaves for instant disease diagnosis.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Plant Disease Detector to access your photo gallery to select plant leaf specimens.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Plant Disease Detector to access your GPS location to fetch real-time localized agro-weather and foliar disease outbreak risks.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you select plant leaves for diagnosis.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to photograph leaves in the field.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: The app accesses your location to fetch agricultural weather and calculate fungal disease risks.
